## Page-By-Page Visual Inspection

Every page of all three PDFs was rendered with Poppler at 140 dpi: 58 rendered
pages in total. The complete page set was inspected in eight contact sheets
(formal 3, rationale 2, ECS 3), with direct attention to covers, contents,
equation blocks, long tables, the owner-decision register, canonical
requirement/prediction inventories, and final pages.

Result: **PASS** for the requested content-focused revision. No clipped or
overlapping text, missing page, blank page, broken equation, overrun table,
misplaced footer/header, or visibly corrupt glyph was found. Page density and
typography are readable and consistent. Final cosmetic refinement remains
separable from this content closure, as directed.
